integrity: The proof consists of explicit gap reduction, fibre-count argument, complete 77-state certificate, and independent full 20736-state deterministic enumeration; finite exhaustive result only.
scientific_limitations: Only four-digit base-twelve padded strings; twelve repdigits separately map to zero. The claimed novelty is the complete exact two-basin population and entry-time census, not a general theorem for all bases; unindexed prior work may exist.
title: Complete attractors and sharp basin-depth distribution for four-digit duodecimal Kaprekar dynamics
